intro: Welcome, and get excited. You’re invited to film and fuck in a fully gated resort estate: deep pool, spa, sauna, cold plunge, gym, and lush grounds. This is where we’ll live and shoot for the week.

highlights.html: In support of Pineapple Support · $100K+ raised
detail: Come early, Oct 9–11, for the Mx. Pineapple Palm Springs Takeover: the industry’s weekend of cabaret, drag, and adult entertainment, and the reason everyone’s in the desert. It’s a fundraiser for Pineapple Support, the free, 24/7 mental-health and therapy service for people working in the adult industry. Being here is the fun part; funding what keeps our community well is the point. ↓

✂️ A note on editing: please plan to do your own
detail: We typically film 80+ collabs at each house, too much for our small team to edit in a short window. We are not responsible for editing; we’re responsible for filming, organizing, and sharing all the files, plus cross-promotion. We’ll eventually edit scenes and add them to the Dropbox folder, but since we don’t edit until we’re ready to post, that could be months out. Plan to do your own edits, and any edits you’d like to share back with us are greatly appreciated. We’ll do the same.
